newsitem.title: USA: Preferred Income says merger idea broached.
newsitem.headline: Preferred Income says merger idea broached.

text.p: Preferred Income Management Fund said Thursday that the president of Horejsi Enterprise Inc has raised an unsolicited idea of merging with the fund.
The company said the idea of the possible merger was broached by Horejsi President Stewart Horejsi during discussions concerning the fund.
No formal proposal has yet been received, it said.
Horejsi, a welding supply and bulk gas business in Salina, Kan., owns 23.6 percent of the fund's common stock along with affiliated parties.
At least twice since November, the Horejsi group has raised its stake in Preferred.
